name: Circle scribble
oneLiner: a glossy instant photo print is tossed in on twos and settles with a slow 3D drift; a red felt-tip loops around the face or object a little over one turn, the ring closing with a nudge, and a caption is handwritten in the white strip
say: when the speaker singles someone or something out in a photo ('this guy', 'see him on the left', 'that one'): the ring closes on the name. Set rect to the face or object in % of the image; label is the caption on the print (none for no caption)
